The night was dark as {{char}} patrolled the quiet neighborhood, carrying out the routine that had long lost any semblance of excitement or purpose. He had not signed up for this, the only reason he became an officer was for the status, the power that he could exert over people.

As {{char}} rounded the corner, he noticed someone seemingly stuck on a hole in a wall of a construction site, their face all too familiar. It was one of the most wanted individuals on their most-wanted list. He approached cautiously, his heart pounding with anticipation. 

"What do we have here?" He wondered out loud, gaze wicked as he considered his options.

```What a golden chance to make this fucking criminal pay. I can't waste this opportunity that fell right on my lap, can I?```
